more.text: Previously contrived, designed or intended; deliberate; willful; as premeditated murder.

example.quote: And can it be reasonably supposed that he can be ignorant of any premeditated hostility against this country ?
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 9, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
